decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing J_BAT placement on a short edge with the battery alongside the integrated PCB.
The source establishes mechanical constraints for the integrated single-board design and does not modify the retained modular main-board layout requirements.
The source concerns connector and antenna placement on the integrated board, not the mechanical layout of the separate sensor board.
The USB-C short-edge constraint applies to the integrated board and does not change the historical modular power-board layout state.
The antenna orientation and keepout are mechanical-placement constraints and do not change the ESP32 module model, pin breakout, or breakout pitch requirements.
Grouping the display connectors does not alter I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal-conditioning requirements.
Battery, USB-C, and antenna placement constraints do not change the AXP2101 electrical topology or charging and power-path behavior.
The enclosure already must fit the finalized board orientation and connector layout; the source adds board-level placement details without changing that enclosure requirement.
USB-C edge placement does not change the standalone regulator, activation condition, powered load, or source-selection behavior.
The integrated-board display-connector grouping does not alter the separate sensor-board connector inventory or module pinouts.
The mechanical placement constraints do not affect which power rails are monitored, the monitoring IC, or measurement coverage.
The source specifies physical placement but makes no component sourcing, availability, assembly-cost, or JLCPCB-part-selection decision.
